source_law.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within the following distances of any fire hydrant, whether or not the location is posted with a sign, whether or not the adjacent curb or roadway surface is painted red, and whether the location is on public or private property: (a) At a location where parallel parking is permitted, fifteen feet; (b) At a location where angle parking is permitted or no parking is permitted, twenty feet.
